name: Crossroads Gold Corp.
summary: Crossroads Gold Corp. is a gold exploration company focused on projects within a short drive of Melbourne in Victoria, Australia. Its projects include Steiglitz Gold, on one of Australia's earliest goldfields, and Pheasant Creek, which hosts underexplored quartz-veined diorite dykes with a strong gold-arsenic-antimony geochemical signature. It was founded in 2014.
